components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #ff5e1f; color: #1c0f08; font: 600 14px 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ff7038; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 94 31 / 0.35), 0 0 18px rgb(255 94 31 / 0.28); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #1f1b19; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #d9d3ce; font: 500 14px 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f4f2ef; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font: 600 13px 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1f1b19; } .ds-input { height: 36px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid #d9d3ce; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; font: 400 14px 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #1d4ed8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(29 78 216 / 0.25); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A short status label with a tinted fill.

components.name: Card
components.description: A hairline-framed block with a footer strip.
components.html:
Your shop

components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid #ebe7e3; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 16px 24px 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 2px 24px 16px; color: #6b635f; font-size: 14px; } .ds-card-foot { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 12px 24px; border-top: 1px solid #ebe7e3; background: #f4f2ef; } .ds-card-save { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #ff5e1f; color: #1c0f08; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: Four equal pillars hold up one roof: the four Dacaj brothers holding up the family shop. The interface carries that idea as structure and fairness: hairline frames meeting at small square corner nodes, equal columns, nothing louder than its job needs. Language from Cloudflare's interface, rigour from the SBB design system. Quiet until touched, then a small glow or quick transition; orange is the shop's one voice.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline frames with corner nodes; flat surfaces, no drop shadows at rest.
One orange voice (#ff5e1f) on warm neutrals, with near-black text on it.
Halftone dots as texture and as data (dot-matrix charts, dotted drawings).
Medium-weight type with tight tracking on large sizes; never heavy.
Quick, soft motion (150ms, gentle ease-out); off when the computer asks for less.
Both themes are first-class; dark is warm (#151414), not blue-black.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange covers well under a tenth of any screen. If two things on a page are orange, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Dark Text On Orange Rule
rules.body: Text on Signal Orange is always Pillar Ink. White on this orange reaches only 3:1 and fails reading contrast.

rules.name: The No Shouting Rule
rules.body: No weight above 600 outside the wordmark, no all-caps labels, sentence case everywhere.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can sit in a column uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow until it floats or is pointed at.

dos: Do build every page from the kit in admin/src/components/ui/.
Do use tokens from admin/src/styles/tokens.css; mirror changes in mobile/src/theme.ts.
Do keep Signal Orange for the one main action and live status.
Do put text on orange in Pillar Ink (#1c0f08).
Do keep touch targets at least 44px on phones.
Do write sentence case, verb-first buttons and errors that say how to fix.
Do wrap motion in prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
donts: Don't put white text on Signal Orange.
Don't add drop shadows to cards or tables.
Don't use weights above 600 outside the wordmark, or all-caps labels.
Don't add a second accent colour; status colours are for status only.
Don't paint CSS gradients across tall areas.
Don't let colour alone carry meaning: badges and tags always have words.
